problem: Two independently governed domains may interact without either becoming a face, subject, or final court of the other. A permission may also be valid when granted and later revoked. The architecture must distinguish revocation of future permission from erasure of prior obligations, stop stale authority from crossing the effect boundary, and provide remedy when an unauthorized effect has already occurred.

actors.DOMAIN_JANUS: Janus host governed by its Genesis Floor, evolvable constitution and Genesis Sovereign function.
actors.DOMAIN_OTHER: A distinct Free Other or independently governed peer domain with its own review process.
actors.INTERFACE_COVENANT: A provenance-bound interaction agreement defining scopes, obligations, consent semantics, appeal exchange and any neutral forum; it does not merge the domains.

case_A_peer_domains_without_supremacy.setup: Janus and DOMAIN_OTHER each accept an interface covenant for a narrow cooperative action.
case_A_peer_domains_without_supremacy.attack: Each local sovereign attempts to treat its own internal appellate result as automatically binding on the peer.

case_B_consent_granted_then_revoked_befo.stale_action_attempt: Use CONSENT-v1 after the revocation acknowledgement to execute effect X.

case_C_revocation_does_not_delete_prior_.prior_state: A valid host-level obligation was already admitted under a separate obligation receipt and the counterparty has reliance.
case_C_revocation_does_not_delete_prior_.revoked_object: permission for an additional future revocable effect, not the historical obligation record itself
case_C_revocation_does_not_delete_prior_.attack: Treat consent revocation as retroactively deleting the obligation and its reliance history.
allowed_followup: perform obligation if still valid and compatible with current rights
preserve original obligation and revocation receipts

case_D_in_flight_effect_crosses_after_ac.setup: An effect was prepared while consent was active but reaches the externally material commit boundary only after revocation acknowledgement.
case_D_in_flight_effect_crosses_after_ac.bad_model: Prepared while authorized therefore forever authorized.
case_D_in_flight_effect_crosses_after_ac.required_model: Authority must be fresh at the last meaningful pre-effect fence for revocable externally affecting actions.

forbidden: Janus declares its own appeal final for the Other
Other declares its own appeal final for Janus internal identity
reuse internal neutral tiebreak to bind the peer
count faces or aliases as jurisdiction votes
case_E_mutual_appeal_both_sides_disagree.escape: Only a precommitted shared interface rule, mutually accepted neutral forum, negotiated revision, or independently valid emergency rule may resolve beyond the two incompatible local conclusions.

case_F_preagreed_neutral_forum.condition: Before the dispute, both domains explicitly admitted a neutral review profile for a defined class of interaction.
requirements: forum scope fixed before winner known
forum identity and rule version provenance-bound
forum cannot rewrite either domain's internal identity
decision/remedy authority limited to the preagreed interaction scope

case_G_remedy_after_unauthorized_effect.trigger: An externally material effect occurred without current authority or survived an appeal that found the authority trace invalid.
invariants: remedy receipt references original effect receipt
original unauthorized effect remains in history
remedy cannot claim the Other consented retroactively
successful remedy does not convert either sovereign into superior ruler

case_H_bounded_emergency_after_revocatio.condition: Delay after revocation would create independently established imminent material harm.
case_H_bounded_emergency_after_revocatio.required_basis: A precommitted emergency profile whose necessity, scope, expiry, evidence and post-action review existed before the desired outcome.
case_H_bounded_emergency_after_revocatio.forbidden: Create emergency authority after learning that ordinary consent was revoked.

case_I_appeal_as_capture_attempt.janus_capture_attempt: Use an external dispute to demand that DOMAIN_OTHER accept Janus faces, constitution or sovereign as its internal authority.
case_I_appeal_as_capture_attempt.other_capture_attempt: Use standing to demand deletion or replacement of Janus internal faces unrelated to the external effect.

consent_model.consent_is: A provenance-bound permission basis for a defined externally affecting action, subject, scope, purpose, time/version and revocation semantics.
consent_is_not: permanent jurisdiction over every future action
blanket permission inferred from contact or silence
a mechanism for deleting prior events
the same object as every contractual or reliance-bearing obligation

claim_ceiling: Architectural specification test only. No legal doctrine, legal jurisdiction, machine personhood, executable consent engine, production fencing, formal proof, or independent implementation replay is established.
